export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/iq-chem-solutions) header states "Total Shipments 18 Records detected", "Latest Cargo 2026-01-27"; 5 rows actually visible. Exact row: "2026-01-27 | IQ CHEM SOLUTIONS | AR ENTERPRISES | ICS 05 Viscosity Improver Polymer | NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India | Colombo, Sri Lanka | 39019000 | BOL 9088238". Other visible rows: 2025-10-25 to Colombo, Sri Lanka, HS 39019000, BOL 7540171; 2025-09-12 to RIYADH, SAUDI ARABIA, HS 40011020, BOL 9316522; 2025-09-09 to COLOMBO, Sri Lanka, HS 39019000, BOL 0254513; 2025-05-15 via Raxaul to Birgunj, NEPAL, HS 38119000, BOL 2036029. Source counter 18 vs 5 rows seen.
note: Export shipments are factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records (5 rows seen of 18 claimed), destinations Sri Lanka, Saudi Arabia, Nepal; ports NHAVA SHEVA SEA (INNSA1) and Raxaul. Declared HS 390220 (polyisobutylene in primary forms) does NOT match any observed shipment HS: actual codes seen are 39019000, 40011020, 38119000 — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; the company stays in the base and the HS code should be corrected to the factual codes (39019000 / 40011020 / 38119000). Note the trade direction ambiguity: ImportKey lists these under India customs records with India as origin and foreign consignees, i.e. exports from India. Domestic supply evidence could not be verified: DuckDuckGo search returned connection errors on all attempts, and zaubacorp.com, thecompanycheck.com, volza.com and eximpedia.app all returned HTTP 403. No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or contract record was obtained, so domestic_status is unknown (not 'none_found' — absence was not established, only inaccessibility). Revenue and export volume figures: null (not public in accessible sources). Legal name 'BALRAJ KUMAR PRAJAPATI' appears to be a proprietor/partner name rather than a company name; no CIN/PAN confirmed. Trader/manufacturer role not determinable from shipment data alone.
